strategies.comments:
Other Options

Choice Band can be used to power up Basculin's attacks, making it a solid wallbreaker against teams without proper counterplay and if ran alongside another Choice Scarf user. However, considering its average Speed and already solid damage output thanks to Adaptability, Basculin finds itself preferring the Speed boost of Choice Scarf a majority of the time. Double-Edge can be used as a more powerful alternative to Psychic Fangs against neutral targets, namely Water Absorb Lapras, but it misses out on hitting targets such as Venusaur, Virizion, and Poliwrath super effectively, and Basculin does not appreciate the recoil either. Tera Water can be used to boost Basculin's STAB moves even further; however, due to the way Terastallization interacts with Adaptability, the damage boost is quite disappointing, with the multiplier only increasing from 2 to 2.25.

Checks and Counters

Physical Walls: Rocky Helmet users such as Weezing, Sableye, and physically defensive Mesprit are able to punish Basculin for using Flip Turn and eventually bring it into range of being KO'd by priority moves.

Water Absorb users: Water Absorb users such as Toxicroak, Lapras, and Poliwrath are able to prevent Basculin from risklessly using Flip Turn and force the Basculin user to make risky predictions in order to make progress.

Faster Choice Scarf users: Pokemon such as Hisuian Sneasel and Dodrio equipped with a Choice Scarf outspeed Basculin and threaten a KO after minimal chip.

Defensive Terastallization: Setup sweepers like Minior and Belly Drum Charizard often use defensive Terastallization such as Tera Grass and Tera Water, which are able to catch Basculin off guard and turn the revenge kill attempt into a setup opportunity. Regirock can also Terastallize out of its Water-type weakness and use Basculin as setup fodder.

Bulky Grass-type Attackers: If Basculin ever finds itself in front of Pokemon such as Choice Specs Arboliva, Trevenant, or Alolan Exeggutor that are not threatened by any of its attacks and deal huge damage back, the Basculin team is often forced to give up one of its Pokemon to take the hit. Dipplin, Abomasnow, and Venusaur can all stomach hits quite well from Basculin but could be exposed to its offensive teammates if it uses Flip Turn as they come in.

movesets.name: Offensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Basculin serves as a fantastic revenge killer thanks to its great Speed, solid damage output, and ability to bring its teammates in with Flip Turn. Equipped with a Choice Scarf, it outspeeds the entirety of the unboosted metagame, as well as potent sweepers such as Minior-Meteor after a Shell Smash and Beartic in Snow. Adaptability-boosted Wave Crash is able to pick up OHKOs on threats such as Jolteon, Sneasel, and Charizard while also having a good chance to OHKO Eviolite Hisuian Sneasel after Stealth Rock. Thanks to Adaptability, Flip Turn often threatens a KO on weakened fast threats and can bring Basculin's teammates into favorable matchups, creating a win-win scenario for it. Aqua Jet, though rarely used, finds its niche in revenge killing boosted threats such as Minior after a Shell Smash and picking off Pokemon like Lycanroc and Hitmontop that can threaten a KO on a worn-down Basculin with their own priority moves. Psychic Fangs allows Basculin to hit Water-resistant and -immune switch-ins such as Virizion, Venusaur, and Poliwrath. With Adaptability, Basculin becomes quite powerful after Terastallization, even against neutral targets, such as Clawitzer and Water Absorb Lapras. A Jolly Nature allows Basculin to outspeed Choice Scarf Primeape and Minior-Meteor after a Shell Smash. If its teammates are comfortable with dealing with these threats, Basculin can opt for an Adamant nature instead, maximizing its damage and notably giving it an 87.5% chance to OHKO Eviolite Hisuian Sneasel with Wave Crash.

Basculin excels on momentum-heavy offense teams that are able to constantly pressure the opponent, keeping entry hazards off and giving Basculin opportunities to enter the field. Compared to more self-sufficient Choice Scarf users, Basculin has very little defensive utility, as it has poor bulk and is prone to being worn down by a combination of hazards, Rocky Helmet, and recoil, making pivots great partners. Vikavolt and Jolteon create good offensive cores with Basculin, while defensive staples such as Mesprit, both specially and physically defensive, and Alolan Persian are able to switch in on a plethora of attacks and bring Basculin in safely. Cryogonal, though not a pivot, is able to blanket check many special attackers such as Vikavolt, Arboliva, and Alolan Exeggutor, which gives Basculin a lot of breathing room, and it is thus a solid teammate. Knock Off users such as Sneasel and Primeape that often bring in the same Rocky Helmet user as Basculin does, helping minimize chip damage. Hazard removal with Basculin is preferred, typically in the form of Sandslash and Hitmontop, the tier's two best spinners. Sandslash provides Spikes and Knock Off, helping whittle down Basculin's checks and removing Rocky Helmets, while Hitmontop works better on offensive teams, since it is a more threatening presence.
